cohort: A 29-year-old gravida 2, para 1 woman presented with early-onset preeclampsia at 26 weeks of gestation, accompanied by severe hyponatremia and significant maternal ascites.
finding: This case report highlights the rare co-occurrence of severe hyponatremia and ascites with preeclampsia, which resolved in the mother following delivery, although neonatal hyponatremia was also noted.
mod_finding: The patient had a cesarean section, after which maternal hyponatremia was corrected and ascites completely resolved in her post-partum visit, indicating that delivery was key to the maternal resolution.
